messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: heuristic simulated annealing over point coordinates with area penalty

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Simulated annealing with a smooth area penalty replacing the hard min—specifically minimizing the soft-min objective $-\\frac{1}{\\lambda}\\log\\sum_{i<j<k} e^{-\\lambda A_{ijk}}$ with $\\lambda$ annealed from 10 to $10^4$—converges to a 13-point configuration in the unit square whose minimum triangle area is at least $0.0034$, with the optimal arrangement exhibiting approximate $D_6$ dihedral symmetry: one point near the center, six points on a rounded hexagonal ring, and six points on an outer ring with alternating radial offsets."}
